card.line: Miletus was a seaport city in Asia Minor, about 36 miles south of Ephesus, where Paul called the Ephesian elders to meet him.

moments.title: Paul Stops at Miletus
moments.text: Paul has decided to sail past Ephesus because he is in a hurry to reach Jerusalem by Pentecost. His ship passes Chios and Samos and then comes to Miletus.

moments.title: Paul Calls the Elders
moments.text: From Miletus, Paul sends for the elders of the church at Ephesus. He reminds them how he served the Lord and taught everyone to turn to God and trust in Jesus. He says he is going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen there, but the Holy Spirit warns him that chains and troubles wait for him.

moments.title: Trophimus Left Sick
moments.text: Paul writes that he left Trophimus sick in Miletus.
